light_note.light_note_1: The charging case indicator light indicates the battery level of the earphones and the case, as well as the case's charging status.
light_note.light_note_2_2: Solid orange: Case not fully charged.
light_note.light_note_3: Open or close the charging case lid, or insert/remove the earphones:
light_note.light_note_3_3: Indicator off: Case powered off due to low battery.
light_note.light_note_4: Open the charging case lid to show the battery levels of both earphones and the case.
light_note.light_note_5: Close the charging case lid to show the case battery and any earphone that is outside the case.

charge_note.charge_note_1_1: Use a USB‑C cable to charge the case
charge_note.charge_note_1_2: The orange indicator light turns solid to show the case is charging.
charge_note.charge_note_1_3: To ensure safe and effective charging, use a certified charger and cable.
charge_note.charge_note_2_1: Place the earphones in the charging case and close the lid to start charging automatically.
charge_note.charge_note_2_2: With the lid open, the earphones aren't charged.

ware_note.ware_note_1: The earphones use an ear‑clip design with a C‑shaped bridge that grips your ear for a lightweight, secure, and stable fit.
ware_note.ware_note_2: Position the larger module behind the ear
ware_note.ware_note_3: Place the smaller module in front of the ear

quick_operation_note.quick_operation_note_1: The earphones are controlled by tapping. Tap the C‑bridge or the front module to control the earphones. Responsiveness depends on tap location, force, and speed. Choose the area that suits your habits for a better experience.
quick_operation_note.quick_operation_note_2_1: Not in a call: double‑tap to play/pause music. (Customisable in the app to: previous track, next track, open voice assistant, or no action.)
quick_operation_note.quick_operation_note_2_2: In a call: double‑tap to answer/end the call. (Customisable in the app to: decline call or no action.)
quick_operation_note.quick_operation_note_2_3: Triple‑tap: triple‑tap the left earphone for the previous track; triple‑tap the right earphone for the next track. (Customisable in the app to: decline call, open TCL Simultaneous Interpretation, or no action.)
quick_operation_note.quick_operation_note_3: You can customise quick actions in the TCL app to suit your needs.

paired_note.paired_note_1: With the earphones in the case, open the lid and press and hold the function button on the case for 2 seconds. The indicator light will flash green, and the earphones enter pairing mode.
paired_note.paired_note_2: For first-time use, open the lid and the earphones will automatically enter pairing mode.
paired_note.paired_note_3: If the currently connected device disconnects, the earphones automatically enter pairing mode.
paired_note.paired_note_4: After powering on, the earphones will reconnect to the last device. If reconnection fails, they will automatically enter pairing mode.
paired_note.paired_note_5: Place the earphones in the case and leave the lid open. Press and hold the function button on the case for 10 seconds; the orange indicator light will flash 3 times, indicating that the factory reset is complete. The earphones will then re-enter pairing mode.

double_device_note.double_device_note_1: The earphones can connect to up to two devices at the same time, but only one device can play audio at a time.
double_device_note.double_device_note_2_1: With the earphones in the case, open the lid and press and hold the function button on the case for 3 seconds until the indicator light flashes green. The earphones will enter pairing mode. On the first device, go to Bluetooth and select the earphones to connect.
double_device_note.double_device_note_2_2: Place the earphones in the case and leave the lid open. Press and hold the function button on the case for 3 seconds until the indicator light flashes green; the earphones will enter pairing mode. On the second device, go to Bluetooth and select the earphones to connect. Once paired, the earphones will automatically reconnect to the first device, establishing a dual‑device connection.
double_device_note.double_device_note_2_3: On the first device, reconnect to the earphones. The earphones are now connected to two devices.
double_device_note.double_device_note_3: Switching rules with two connected devices:
double_device_note.double_device_note_3_1: Calls take priority over music/video. If one device is playing music/video and the other has a call, the earphones switch to the call audio.
double_device_note.double_device_note_3_2: If the two devices receive calls one after another, the earphones prioritise the most recent incoming call.
double_device_note.double_device_note_3_3: If the two devices start playing music/videos one after another, the earphones prioritise playing audio from the first device; the second device will be silent. Pause music/videos on the first device to play music/videos from the second device.
double_device_note.double_device_note_4: After connecting to two devices, put the earphones in the case and close the lid to disconnect. Open the lid to automatically reconnect to both devices.

connect_note.connect_note_1: Auto disconnect when the lid Is closed
connect_note.connect_note_1_1: Place the earphones in the charging case and close the lid; the Bluetooth connection will disconnect.
connect_note.connect_note_2: Auto reconnect when the lid Is opened
connect_note.connect_note_2_1: With the earphones in the case, open the lid and they will automatically reconnect to the most recently connected device.
connect_note.connect_note_3: Auto reconnect when within range again
connect_note.connect_note_3_1: In an open, interference‑free environment, the effective range for music and calls is up to 10 metres. When exceeding this range, audio may stutter, mute, or the earphones may disconnect. Return within range shortly and they will reconnect automatically. If reconnection fails, place the earbuds in the case, close the lid, then open it to reconnect.

update_note.update_note_1: After connecting the earphones to your phone or tablet, use the TCL Home App to update to the latest version.
update_note.update_note_3: Make sure the earphones are connected, then tap the earphones card to enter.
update_note.update_note_4: Tap the "…" in the upper right to open Settings, then tap "Device version".  If a new version is available, tap to download and install, and wait for the update to complete.
update_note.update_note_5: Ensure the earphones' battery is at least 20%.
update_note.update_note_6: Keep the earphones connected during the update. Don't operate the earphones while the update is in progress.

clean_note.clean_note_1: For better performance (sound quality, noise cancellation, and call experience) and to help prevent ear‑canal irritation, clean and maintain the earphones regularly (about once per week).
clean_note.clean_note_2: You may use alcohol or disinfectant wipes to clean the exterior surfaces of the wireless earphones. Don't use these wipes on the ear tips, ear cushions, charging contacts or port, speaker mesh, or microphone holes, to prevent moisture or water ingress.
clean_note.clean_note_3: Cleaning the charging case, charging port, and charging contacts:
clean_note.clean_note_3_1: Use a soft, dry cloth to clean the charging case. If needed, you can wipe the exterior with a wipe containing 70% alcohol. Let the case air‑dry completely before placing the earphones back inside.
clean_note.clean_note_3_2: Use a clean, dry soft‑bristle brush to remove any debris from the charging port.
clean_note.clean_note_3_3: Use a clean, dry pointed cotton swab to gently wipe the charging contacts on the case.
clean_note.clean_note_3_4: Don't use a water‑soaked cloth. Avoid excessive force while wiping to prevent deforming or damaging the charging pins contacts in the case.
clean_note.clean_note_4: Cleaning the noise cancellation ports, front and rear tuning ports, and main microphone port. Use a clean, dry pointed cotton swab to gently brush out dirt and earwax from the sound outlet, then wipe clean with a soft cloth.

healthy_note.healthy_note_1: The earphones should maintain close contact with your skin. A proper, snug fit improves comfort and ensures optimal acoustic performance, including sound quality and noise cancellation.
healthy_note.healthy_note_2: If multiple ear tip sizes or integrated ear wings are included, choose the size that fits you best. If one side feels loose, you can use different tip sizes for the left and right ears.
healthy_note.healthy_note_3: Using earphones at high volume for extended time can damage hearing. We recommend limiting each listening session to no more than 60 minutes and keeping the volume below 60% of maximum. Remove the earphones before sleeping.
healthy_note.healthy_note_4: If sweat, soap, skincare products, or similar substances are on the earphones, keep both the earphones and your skin dry and clean to prevent long-term damage to the earphones.
healthy_note.healthy_note_5: Avoid sharing earphones with others. When the ear cushions become dirty or after one month of continuous use, remove them promptly and wipe them with a wet wipe or wash with clean water and let them air dry to prevent bacterial growth.
healthy_note.healthy_note_6: If you experience itching, redness, or other irritation reactions, we recommend that you stop using the earphones immediately and clean them, then observe whether your discomfort resolves on its own. If your symptoms are more pronounced, consult a doctor to decide whether to continue wearing the earphones.

reset_device.reset_note_3: 3. Close the lids of any other earphone cases that you don't want to pair.
